LeadToSheet

Every lead. One sheet. Hot ones on top.

Seller identity hidden — sign up to reveal

What it does LeadToSheet automatically captures website form submissions and syncs them straight to Google Sheets — no Zapier, no developer work required. Clients drop a small JavaScript snippet on their site; the SDK intercepts every form submission, fingerprints the form, captures lead data (plus UTM params, click IDs, and browser context), and pushes it to a connected sheet within seconds. Beyond core capture-and-sync functionality, it includes AI-powered lead processing (scoring, summaries, and company enrichment from email domains), real-time alerts to Slack/Discord/Teams, webhooks, hosted forms with a form builder, and an MCP server for AI tool access. How it makes money Recurring SaaS subscriptions billed through Stripe: - Starter — $9/mo (up to 100 submissions) - Growth — $29/mo (up to 500) - Professional — $49/mo (unlimited) - Annual plans available at approximately 2 months free There's also an AppSumo lifetime deal channel (three tiers) and a built-in partner/referral program with commission tracking and payouts. Current MRR is £50. Who the users are Small businesses, marketers, and agencies that collect leads through website forms and want them organized in a spreadsheet they already use — without paying for or configuring heavier automation tools. The SDK install works on any site (WordPress, Webflow, custom HTML, etc.). What's included in the sale Everything needed to run and grow the business: - Domain — leadtosheet.com - IP & codebase — full source: Next.js 16 app, client SDK, marketing site, partner portal, admin tooling - Tech — production infrastructure on Vercel, PostgreSQL/Prisma, Stripe billing, Google OAuth integration, Resend email, Sentry monitoring - Customers — existing paying customers and their accounts - Revenue — current £50 MRR and the AppSumo listing/channel - Extras — SEO content (comparison pages, form guides, integrations pages), partner program, and supporting scripts

TurboStarter

AI-optimized starter kit for web apps, mobile apps, and browser extensions—ready in 5 minutes

Seller identity hidden — sign up to reveal

TurboStarter is a production-ready fullstack starter kit (sold as a downloadable codebase, docs, and community access) that lets developers and small teams launch web apps, mobile apps, and browser extensions in minutes instead of months. It's a turborepo monorepo where every standard SaaS building block ships pre-built and modular—think Lego blocks: - Multi-platform from one codebase: web (Next.js), mobile (React Native + Expo), browser extension (WXT) - Auth: email/password, magic links, OAuth (Google, GitHub), passkeys, MFA, anonymous - Multi-tenancy: organizations, teams, invitations, roles & permissions - Billing: subscriptions and one-time payments across Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo, RevenueCat, Superwall - AI kit: streaming chat, agents, RAG, image generation, TTS, voice (LiveKit), 10+ ready-to-ship AI templates, multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, ElevenLabs, and more) - Database with type-safe queries and migrations, S3 storage, transactional and marketing emails (Resend/SendGrid/Nodemailer + React Email) - Admin panel with user management, roles, and impersonation - i18n, analytics (PostHog/GA/Plausible/Umami/OpenPanel/Vemetric), monitoring (Sentry/PostHog), SEO, blog, MDX CMS, legal pages - Deployment guides (Vercel, Railway, Docker, Render, Fly.io, AWS), CI/CD, mobile OTA updates, unit/integration/E2E test setup - AI-assisted development built in: Cursor rules, Claude skills, custom subagents, MCP, and an llms.txt so Cursor/Claude/Codex/Antigravity understand the codebase out of the box Sold as four SKUs—core kit, AI kit, UI kit, OpenClaw wrapper kit—plus an all-in-one bundle, backed by a docs site (turbostarter.dev/docs and /ai/docs), six live demos (web, iOS, Android, Chrome, Firefox, Edge), and a private Discord. One-time license sales processed through Lemon Squeezy (merchant of record, handles global VAT/sales tax automatically—no PSP or tax setup needed). Who uses TurboStarter? - Indie hackers and solo founders shipping their first (or next) SaaS who want to skip 2–3 months of boilerplate - AI startup builders who need production-ready templates for chat, RAG, voice, image, and agents instead of stitching them together - Small product teams and agencies building cross-platform products (web, mobile, extension) from one shared codebase - Developers using AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity) who want a repo already optimized with rules, skills, subagents, MCP, and llms.txt Active paying customer base with public testimonials, Discord community, and listings live in the App Store, Play Store, Chrome Web Store, Firefox Add-ons, and Edge Add-ons—approximately 300 users.

sample.title: LeadToSheet
sample.summary:
Every lead. One sheet. Hot ones on top. What it does

LeadToSheet automatically captures website form submissions and syncs them straight to Google Sheets — no Zapier, no developer work required. Clients drop a small JavaScript snippet on their site; the SDK intercepts every form submission, fingerprints the form, captures lead data (plus UTM params, click IDs, and browser context), and pushes it to a connected sheet within seconds.

Beyond core capture-and-sync functionality, it includes AI-powered lead processing (scoring, summaries, and company enrichment from email domains), real-time alerts to Slack/Discord/Teams, webhooks, hosted forms with a form builder, and an MCP server for AI tool access.

How it makes money

Recurring SaaS subscriptions billed through Stripe:
- Starter — $9/mo (up to 100 submissions)
- Growth — $29/mo (up to 500)
- Professional — $49/mo (unlimited)
- Annual plans available at approximately 2 months free

There's also an AppSumo lifetime deal channel (three tiers) and a built-in partner/referral program with commission tracking and payouts. Current MRR is £50.

Who the users are

Small businesses, marketers, and agencies that collect leads through website forms and want them organized in a spreadsheet they already use — without paying for or configuring heavier automation tools. The SDK install works on any site (WordPress, Webflow, custom HTML, etc.).

What's included in the sale

Everything needed to run and grow the business:

sample.title: TurboStarter
sample.summary:
AI-optimized starter kit for web apps, mobile apps, and browser extensions—ready in 5 minutes TurboStarter is a production-ready fullstack starter kit (sold as a downloadable codebase, docs, and community access) that lets developers and small teams launch web apps, mobile apps, and browser extensions in minutes instead of months.

It's a turborepo monorepo where every standard SaaS building block ships pre-built and modular—think Lego blocks:

- Multi-platform from one codebase: web (Next.js), mobile (React Native + Expo), browser extension (WXT)
- Auth: email/password, magic links, OAuth (Google, GitHub), passkeys, MFA, anonymous
- Multi-tenancy: organizations, teams, invitations, roles & permissions
- Billing: subscriptions and one-time payments across Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Polar, Dodo, RevenueCat, Superwall
- AI kit: streaming chat, agents, RAG, image generation, TTS, voice (LiveKit), 10+ ready-to-ship AI templates, multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, ElevenLabs, and more)
- Database with type-safe queries and migrations, S3 storage, transactional and marketing emails (Resend/SendGrid/Nodemailer + React Email)
- Admin panel with user management, roles, and impersonation
- i18n, analytics (PostHog/GA/Plausible/Umami/OpenPanel/Vemetric), monitoring (Sentry/PostHog), SEO, blog, MDX CMS, legal pages
- Deployment guides (Vercel, Railway, Docker, Render, Fly.io, AWS), CI/CD, mobile OTA updates, unit/integration/E2E test setup
- AI-assisted development built in: Cursor rules, Claude skills, custom subagents, MCP, and an llms.txt so Cursor/Claude/Codex/Antigravity understand the codebase out of the box

Sold as four SKUs—core kit, AI kit, UI kit, OpenClaw wrapper kit—plus an all-in-one bundle, backed by a docs site (turbostarter.dev/docs and /ai/docs), six live demos (web, iOS, Android, Chrome, Firefox, Edge), and a private Discord.

One-time license sales processed through Lemon Squeezy (merchant of record, handles global VAT/sales tax au
